36.0.en: A small [[conjunction:conjunction]] joined our tales with [[consistent:consistent]] love and care.
36.0.zh: 一个小小的连词，把我们的故事稳稳连在一起，始终满含关爱。

36.1.en: The long [[tale:tale]] seemed [[complicated:complicated]], so we [[compile:compiled]] our notes together to make it clearer.
36.1.zh: 那个长故事看着复杂，我们把笔记汇编到一起，它就清楚多了。

36.2.en: Each week we read a new [[version:version]] and then [[paraphrase:paraphrase]] it in easy words.
36.2.zh: 每个星期我们都读一个新版本，再用简单的话把它改述一遍。

36.3.en: Anna helped us [[interpret:interpret]] the old tales and [[narrate:narrate]] them with smiles.
36.3.zh: 安娜帮我们解读老故事，再笑眯眯地讲述出来。

36.4.en: Bright lamps [[illuminate:illuminate]] our room as we [[decipher:decipher]] the old cards together.
36.4.zh: 明亮的灯照亮屋子，我们一起慢慢破译一张张旧卡片。

36.5.en: Her soft [[eloquence:eloquence]] helped us [[communicate:communicate]] warm thoughts to friends.
36.5.zh: 她柔和的口才帮我们把暖心的话传达给朋友。

37.0.en: Thursday brought a long [[discussion:discussion]] and a quick, [[lively:lively]] [[brainstorm:brainstorm]] at noon.
37.0.zh: 周四有一场长长的讨论，中午又来了一次热闹的快节奏头脑风暴。

37.1.en: Our friendly [[commentary:commentary]] helped us [[negotiate:negotiate]] plans without raised voices.
37.1.zh: 友善的互相点评，让我们商量计划时谁也没提高嗓门。

37.2.en: No [[contention:contention]] remained, because each clear [[medium:medium]] carried kind news.
37.2.zh: 争执没有留下，因为每一种清楚的媒介传出的都是善意的消息。

37.3.en: Friday papers caught the rush of the [[press:press]], while a young [[journalist:journalist]] smiled nearby.
37.3.zh: 周五的报纸赶上了新闻界发稿的高峰，一位年轻记者在一旁微笑。

37.4.en: A fair [[critic:critic]] praised the young [[commentator:commentator]], and she had only warm words for him.
37.4.zh: 一位公正的评论家表扬了那位年轻评论员，她说的全是暖心的话。

37.5.en: A stately [[exponent:exponent]] of the school music club thanked the clear-voiced [[announcer:announcer]].
37.5.zh: 学校音乐社团德高望重的倡导者，向那位吐字清晰的报幕员道了谢。

38.0.en: Our kind [[correspondent:correspondent]] met the quick [[messenger:messenger]] by the tall tree.
38.0.zh: 我们好心的通讯记者，在大树旁遇上了腿脚飞快的送信人。

38.1.en: The tired [[editor:editor]] helped the fast [[typist:typist]] finish the pages before lunch.
38.1.zh: 疲惫的编辑帮打字飞快的打字员，赶在午饭前完成了那几页稿子。

38.2.en: Each printed [[handout:handout]] flew across the room with a bright [[leaflet:leaflet]].
38.2.zh: 印好的讲义带着鲜亮的小传单，在教室里飞来飞去。

38.3.en: The loud [[propaganda:propaganda]] faded as friends chose to [[publish:publish]] only true stories they had checked themselves.
38.3.zh: 喧嚣的宣传声淡去，朋友们决定只发表自己核实过的真实报道。

38.4.en: Good news was easy to [[disseminate:disseminate]], and sunny days could be [[foresee:foreseen]] with smiles.
38.4.zh: 好消息容易传播，晴天也能笑着预见。

38.5.en: Pleasure was [[anticipate:anticipated]] for the Friday fair, and every friend was [[expect:expected]] to come.
38.5.zh: 大家早早盼着周五的游园会，每位朋友都在被期待之列。

39.0.en: Warm smiles were [[await:awaited]] as each sweet [[pastime:pastime]] filled the evening.
39.0.zh: 温暖的笑容在等着大家，一项项惬意的消遣填满了傍晚。

39.1.en: Songs [[entertain:entertain]] the children and bring quiet [[recreation:recreation]] after busy days.
39.1.zh: 歌声让孩子们开心，也在忙碌一天后带来安静的休憩。

39.2.en: Tales [[amuse:amuse]] our friends, while idle [[gossip:gossip]] about others stays far away.
39.2.zh: 故事逗乐了朋友，背后嚼舌的闲话则离我们远远的。

39.3.en: No low [[rumour:rumour]] can break our warm [[consensus:consensus]] to help each other.
39.3.zh: 再不堪的谣言也破坏不了我们互助的温暖共识。

39.4.en: Saturday woke with a bright [[festival:festival]] mood and a sweet [[feast:feast]] at noon.
39.4.zh: 星期六在明快的节日气氛中醒来，中午还有一场甜美的盛宴。

39.5.en: Our short [[program:program]] needed one quick [[rehearsal:rehearsal]] before lunch today.
39.5.zh: 我们的小节目得赶在今天午饭前快速排练一遍。

40.0.en: Children love to [[imitate:imitate]] birds and [[mimic:mimic]] their kind teachers, laughing happily.
40.0.zh: 孩子们爱模仿小鸟，也爱学慈爱的老师说话，笑声不断。

40.1.en: We [[simulate:simulated]] the sound of rain before the small [[circus:circus]] show at [[dusk:dusk]].
40.1.zh: 黄昏小马戏开场前，我们先模拟了一阵雨声。

40.2.en: Simple [[magic:magic]] tricks opened the funny [[drama:drama]] near the tall trees.
40.2.zh: 大树旁，几招简单的小魔术拉开了滑稽戏剧的序幕。

40.3.en: The loud evening [[concert:concert]] held one soft, sweet [[symphony:symphony]] for everyone.
40.3.zh: 热闹的晚间音乐会上，有一段又轻又美的交响乐送给大家。

40.4.en: Our small [[orchestra:orchestra]] bowed beside the new [[ballet:ballet]] dancers in white.
40.4.zh: 小小的管弦乐队，在一身白衣的新芭蕾演员身旁鞠躬致意。

40.5.en: The [[gentle:gentle]] [[opera:opera]] warmed hearts more than loud [[comedy:comedy]] jokes at [[night:night]].
40.5.zh: 温柔的歌剧，比夜里喧闹的喜剧段子更暖人心。

41.0.en: Tears from the soft [[tragedy:tragedy]] dried as the bright [[animation:animation]] lit up the room.
41.0.zh: 温柔悲剧带来的眼泪未干，明快的动画又把屋子照亮。

41.1.en: A short [[film:film]] glowed on the screen before the long [[movie:movie]] made us laugh.
41.1.zh: 短片先在幕布上亮起，后面的长电影逗得我们大笑。

41.2.en: No [[x-rated:x-rated]] show was played, while a young [[artist:artist]] made flowers look alive.
41.2.zh: 现场没放任何限制级节目，年轻画家笔下的花朵栩栩如生。

41.3.en: A wise [[craftsman:craftsman]] helped the calm [[painter:painter]] carry the bright boards.
41.3.zh: 手艺高明的老匠人，帮沉静的画家搬那摞亮闪闪的画板。

41.4.en: Each new [[role:role]] lit a fresh [[scene:scene]] with warm [[gentle:gentle]] light.
41.4.zh: 每接一个新角色，就用温暖柔和的光点亮新的一幕。

41.5.en: We swept the small [[stage:stage]] and hung pictures in the bright [[gallery:gallery]] room.
41.5.zh: 我们打扫了小舞台，又在明亮的画廊里挂好画。

42.0.en: Each small [[exhibition:exhibition]] showed a calm [[aesthetic:aesthetic]] pleasure in simple lines.
42.0.zh: 每场小展览，都在简洁的线条里透出宁静的美感。

42.1.en: We helped [[collect:collect]] shells and [[select:select]] [[smooth:smooth]] stones by the lake.
42.1.zh: 我们在湖边帮忙捡贝壳，又挑选了光滑的石头。

42.2.en: Children may [[opt:opt]] to make pictures and then [[photograph:photograph]] flowers with phones.
42.2.zh: 孩子们可以自由选择画画，再用手机给花儿拍照。

42.3.en: Each smiling [[portrait:portrait]] hung beside a bright [[painting:painting]] of birds.
42.3.zh: 每张带笑的肖像，都挂在明快的鸟类画作旁边。

42.4.en: A stone [[sculpture:sculpture]] stood nearby as Lily began to [[draw:draw]] the clouds above.
42.4.zh: 石雕立在一旁，莉莉开始画它上方的云。

42.5.en: We watched her [[depict:depict]] the birds and then [[describe:describe]] the wind in easy words.
42.5.zh: 我们看她描绘小鸟，再用简单的话描述那阵风。

43.0.en: Old hands [[carve:carve]] wood while children [[improvise:improvise]] songs with quick smiles.
43.0.zh: 老手艺人雕刻木头，孩子们笑着一首首即兴编歌。

43.1.en: Sunday songs felt [[musical:musical]] and soft, with [[classical:classical]] strings at [[dawn:dawn]].
43.1.zh: 星期天的歌柔和动听，天刚亮时还响起古典的弦乐。

43.2.en: Sweet [[jazz:jazz]] notes mixed with loud [[rock:rock]] beats near the lake.
43.2.zh: 甜甜的爵士音符，和湖边响亮的摇滚节拍混在一起。

43.3.en: Cool [[hip-hop:hip-hop]] dances joined soft [[pop:pop]] songs under bright clouds.
43.3.zh: 帅气的嘻哈舞步，配着晴空下轻柔的流行歌。

43.4.en: Warm [[lyric:lyric]] words filled the air as a small [[band:band]] played nearby.
43.4.zh: 温暖的歌词飘满空气，一支小乐队在旁边演奏。

43.5.en: A shy [[solo:solo]] rose over a sweet, soft [[melody:melody]] at [[sunrise:sunrise]].
43.5.zh: 日出时分，一段怯生生的独唱飘荡在甜美柔和的旋律之上。

44.0.en: The quick [[rhythm:rhythms]] matched each low, mellow [[tone:tone]] with pleasure.
44.0.zh: 飞快的节奏，正好配上下沉而圆润的每一个音。

44.1.en: We hummed one warm [[tune:tune]] and spun an old black [[disc:disc]] slowly.
44.1.zh: 我们哼着暖暖的曲调，慢慢转动那张旧黑唱片。

44.2.en: In the room, a black [[piano:piano]] stood beside an old brown [[violin:violin]].
44.2.zh: 屋里，一架黑钢琴靠着一把旧棕色小提琴立着。

44.3.en: A deep [[cello:cello]] sighed while a long [[guitar:guitar]] rang clear and sweet.
44.3.zh: 低沉的大提琴在叹息，长颈吉他却响得清亮甜美。

44.4.en: A tiny [[harmonica:harmonica]] sang with a bright gold [[trumpet:trumpet]] at noon.
44.4.zh: 正午，小小的口琴和金色的小号一起歌唱。

44.5.en: A small [[drum:drum]] thumped as a silver [[flute:flute]] whistled over the yard.
44.5.zh: 小鼓咚咚作响，银色长笛的哨音在院子里飘荡。

45.0.en: Our friendly [[competition:competition]] felt kinder than the [[grand:grand]] [[tournament:tournament]] downtown.
45.0.zh: 我们友好的小比赛，比市中心那场盛大的锦标赛更让人觉得亲切。

45.1.en: Each [[olympic:Olympic]] dream was carried by a [[sponsor:sponsor]] waving bright flags on the field.
45.1.zh: 每一个奥林匹克梦想，都有场边挥舞鲜艳旗帜的赞助商相随。

45.2.en: A [[gentle:gentle]] [[patron:patron]] cheered each tired [[athlete:athlete]] with warm tea.
45.2.zh: 和气的赞助人端来热茶，为每位疲惫的运动员加油。

45.3.en: The young [[champion:champion]] waved to each happy [[spectator:spectator]] in the yard.
45.3.zh: 年轻的冠军朝院子里每位开心的观众挥手。

45.4.en: Each kind [[volunteer:volunteer]] wore a clean bright shirt and looked [[famous:famous]] on the school website.
45.4.zh: 每位热心志愿者都穿着干净鲜亮的衬衫，在学校网站上看着像大明星。

45.5.en: A [[well-known:well-known]] teacher brought [[energetic:energetic]] games to the sunny yard.
45.5.zh: 一位知名老师把一个个活力满满的游戏带到了洒满阳光的院子。

46.0.en: [[vigorous:Vigorous]] cheers filled the wide, sunny [[stadium:stadium]] all afternoon.
46.0.zh: 整整一下午，响亮的欢呼声填满了宽阔向阳的体育场。

46.1.en: Our small [[gym:gym]] held morning [[training:training]] with ropes and soft mats.
46.1.zh: 清晨的小体育馆里，大家用绳子和软垫开始训练。

46.2.en: Light [[exercise:exercise]] woke us in the soft [[indoor:indoor]] air before breakfast.
46.2.zh: 早饭前，轻缓的练习在柔和的室内空气里把我们唤醒。

46.3.en: Fresh [[outdoor:outdoor]] air made every child [[mobile:mobile]] again, and they ran to the trees.
46.3.zh: 清新的户外空气让孩子们重新活络起来，一个个朝树下跑去。

46.4.en: Slow [[movement:movement]] calmed us before [[gentle:gentle]] morning [[yoga:yoga]] by the lake.
46.4.zh: 舒缓的活动让我们平静下来，随后到湖边做温柔的晨间瑜伽。

46.5.en: We kept the blankets tidy and helped friends [[stretch:stretch]] their arms with laughs.
46.5.zh: 我们把毯子收得整整齐齐，又笑着帮朋友伸展手臂。

47.0.en: Heavy [[strain:strain]] faded before a quick game of [[chess:chess]] calmed our minds.
47.0.zh: 沉重的紧绷感散去，一盘快棋让心绪安定下来。

47.1.en: Light [[badminton:badminton]] rallies felt easier than long [[golf:golf]] walks at noon.
47.1.zh: 轻松的羽毛球对打，比中午绕着球场走一大圈的高尔夫省力多了。

47.2.en: Long [[billiards:billiards]] cues rested beside bright [[soccer:soccer]] balls in the room.
47.2.zh: 长长的台球杆斜靠在屋里亮闪闪的足球旁边。

47.3.en: Quick [[tennis:tennis]] balls flew near the tall [[volleyball:volleyball]] nets at [[dawn:dawn]].
47.3.zh: 天刚亮，飞快的网球就在高高的排球网边穿梭。

47.4.en: New [[hockey:hockey]] sticks leaned beside a white, [[round:round]] [[goal:goal]] [[frame:frame]] near the door.
47.4.zh: 新的曲棍球杆斜靠在门边白色圆圆的球门框旁。

47.5.en: An old [[wooden:wooden]] [[bat:bat]] rested beside a light [[racket:racket]] on the bench.
47.5.zh: 长凳上，一根旧木球棒和一支轻巧的球拍并排靠着。

paraZh.36: 汇编笔记解读老故事，灯下共读。
paraZh.37: 周四讨论协商，周五媒体人物亮相。
paraZh.38: 编辑赶稿发讲义，只传核实过的真消息。
paraZh.39: 歌谣消遣拒谣言，周六盛宴将启。
paraZh.40: 马戏魔术音乐会，夜晚暖意连连。
paraZh.41: 动画电影治愈人心，画廊挂画忙。
paraZh.42: 湖边捡石办小展，画云描鸟说风。
paraZh.43: 周日晨歌，爵士摇滚流行齐鸣。
paraZh.44: 旧唱片转起来，满屋乐器各显身手。
paraZh.45: 赛场温情涌动，志愿者风光亮相。
paraZh.47: 棋盘定心，球具列队各就各位。
